About Us
Meet Rhino Lodge & Hotel, a warm, family-run jungle lodge in Sauraha at the gateway to Chitwan National Park. Our story, our team and our promise to guests.
A family-run Jungle Lodge in Sauraha
Rhino Lodge & Hotel is a warm, family-run jungle lodge in the heart of Sauraha, right at the gateway to Chitwan National Park in Nepal. For years we ve welcomed travellers from Nepal and around the world with comfortable, air-conditioned rooms, a garden pool and genuine Tharu-region hospitality all just minutes from where wild one-horned rhinos roam. Our name says it best: at Rhino Lodge, the wildlife often comes to you.
Read Our Story
Four decades on the edge of the jungle
Our Story
Rhino Lodge & Hotel opened its doors in  1984 , in the early days of tourism in Sauraha when Chitwan National Park was still a well-kept secret and the village was little more than a handful of homes along the Rapti River.
What began as a small family guesthouse has grown, season by season, into one of Sauraha s most trusted lodges. Through all of it we ve stayed  family-owned and family-run, the same people who welcomed the first guests still greet you at the gate today.
Over forty years we ve guided tens of thousands of travelers into the park, watched the one-horned rhino recover from the brink, and grown alongside the community and the wildlife we depend on. We re proud of how far Chitwan has come, and grateful to still be here at the heart of it.
The Rhino Lodge Way
Comfort, Care & Chitwan Soul
For over forty years, Rhino Lodge & Hotel has welcomed travellers to Sauraha with warm hospitality, licensed naturalist guides, and a genuine love for the jungle we call home.
Discover more
What We Stand For
The things that haven't changed since 1984
For over four decades, some things have remained at the heart of Rhino Lodge & Hotel: welcoming guests like family, sharing Chitwan through knowledgeable local guides, caring for its wildlife and environment, and staying closely connected to the community. As Sauraha has grown, our commitment to authentic hospitality and responsible tourism has remained unchanged.
Genuine hospitality
You re a guest in our home, not a booking number. Warm, personal service is the reason most of our guests come back.
Expert guiding
Every safari is led by a government-licensed naturalist who knows Chitwan s wildlife, seasons and quiet corners.
Responsible tourism
We favour low-impact, ethical wildlife experiences and support conservation of the park that sustains us.
Rooted in community
We employ locally and celebrate the Tharu culture. Both the community and the lodge have grown up together.
Trusted since 1984
Why Guests Choose Us
For over four decades, some things have remained at the heart of Rhino Lodge & Hotel: welcoming guests like family, sharing Chitwan through knowledgeable local guides, caring for its wildlife and environment, and staying closely connected to the community. As Sauraha has grown, our commitment to authentic hospitality and responsible tourism has remained unchanged.
Four decades of experience
One of Sauraha s longest-running lodges, with a 4.7/5 rating across 327+ reviews on Google and TripAdvisor.
Licensed & certified
Government-licensed naturalist guides and all required tourism permits. You are in safe, expert hands.
Prime Sauraha location
At Gaida Chowk on the very edge of the park minutes from the river, the guides and the jungle.
Ethical & local
Responsible wildlife experiences, local employment, and real support for the Tharu community.
A comfortable nature-focused hotel in Sauraha, Chitwan, offering welcoming accommodation, relaxing surroundings and easy access to Chitwan National Park and the region's wildlife, culture and adventure experiences.

The package
What this Chitwan jungle-safari
package includes?
One simple booking covers your stay, meals, park permits, a licensed naturalist guide and every activity below. You arrive in Sauraha, we handle the rest, so your time goes to wildlife, not logistics.
Every package includes accommodation at Rhino Lodge & Hotel, all meals (breakfast, lunch and dinner), Chitwan National Park entry permits, a government-licensed nature guide, all listed jungle activities, the Tharu cultural evening, and transfers within Sauraha.
International flights, drinks and personal expenses are not included.
On Safari
Activities on your Sauraha Safari
A balanced mix of wildlife, river and culture. Your guide adjusts the order to the season and the day s conditions.
Jeep Safari
Drive deep into the core zone in an open 4×4 with a naturalist and spotter, tracking rhino, deer and if you're lucky enough may be sloth bear or tiger.
Canoe Trip
Glide silently down the river in a traditional dugout canoe past basking gharial and mugger crocodiles and dozens of waterbirds.
Guided Jungle walk
Follow your naturalist on foot through sal forest and grassland to read tracks, spot birds and learn how the jungle works up close.
Elephant Breeding Centre
Visit the government breeding centre to see mothers and calves and learn about conservation, an ethical, hands-off experience.
Tharu Cultural Show
Glide silently down the river in a traditional dugout canoe past basking gharial and mugger crocodiles and dozens of waterbirds.
Bird Watching Rapti Sunset
Chitwan hosts 500+ bird species. Catch an early-morning birding walk and a golden sunset over the river to close the day.

Choose a 1 Night/2 Days getaway or a relaxed 3 Nights/4 Days adventure, with clear prices.
Day 1 Arrival & Culture
Welcome to Sauraha
Arrive at Rhino Lodge, welcome drink and lunch, then check in. In the afternoon, walk to a Tharu village and the Elephant Breeding Centre.
As the sun sets over the Rapti, settle in for the Tharu stick-dance cultural show, followed by dinner.
Day 2 Full safari day
Into Chitwan National Park
Arrive at Rhino Lodge, welcome drink and lunch, then check in. In the afternoon, walk to a Tharu village and the Elephant Breeding Centre.
As the sun sets over the Rapti, settle in for the Tharu stick-dance cultural show, followed by dinner.
Day 3 Departure
One last morning
Optional sunrise bird watching or a slow riverside breakfast, then check out. We arrange your onward transfer to Kathmandu, Pokhara or Bharatpur Airport.
